career_ladder.note: Junior Engineers-I (JEN-I) in Rajasthan State Power Companies are recruited through a centralized Common Recruitment Exercise conducted by Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited (RVUNL) on behalf of all five State Power Utilities (RVUN, RVPN, JVVN, AVVN, JdVVN). Officers are appointed across thermal and hydel generating stations, transmission grids, and distribution circles, advancing through executive and chief engineer ranks under the Rajasthan Power Sector Engineers Service Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: Recruitment to the post of Junior Engineer-I is conducted through a single-stage online Computer Based Test (CBT) Common Written Competitive Examination of two hours duration (120 minutes) consisting entirely of multiple-choice questions. The question paper carries two parts: Part A (60% weightage - Degree-level Engineering discipline) and Part B (40% weightage - General Aptitude, Reasoning, Mathematics, Rajasthan GK & Everyday Science, Hindi, and English). Penalty for wrong answers is applied. There is strictly no interview; merit is determined on total scores across Part A and Part B, followed by certificate verification.

financial_package.note: Junior Engineers-I in Rajasthan Power Sector are placed in Pay Matrix Level L-10 (entry basic pay ₹33,800, equivalent to Grade Pay ₹3,600 under 6th CPC) in accordance with the Rajasthan Vidyut Nigams (Revised Pay) Regulations. Newly recruited candidates undergo a mandatory two-year probation training period during which they draw a fixed stipend of ₹23,700 per month. Upon satisfactory completion of probation, regular pay scale benefits and allowances commence.
financial_package.pay_source_label: RVUNL Detailed Advt. No. RVUN/Rectt.-2026-27/02 Section 2 Remuneration/Salary
financial_package.estimate_note: Post-probation gross earnings comprise Entry Basic Pay ₹33,800 + 58% DA (₹19,604) + HRA ranging from 10% (₹3,380 in rural/plant sites) to 20% (₹6,760 in Y-class cities like Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota) + Thermal Power Generation Allowance / Shift Allowance where posted in thermal plants (Kota, Suratgarh, Chhabra, Kalisindh). In-hand salary reflects mandatory deductions under Contributory Pension Scheme / NPS (10% of Basic+DA = ₹5,340) and group insurance. During the two-year probation period, fixed remuneration is ₹23,700 per month.
official_perks: Subsidized electricity allowance / energy quota as per Vidyut Nigam service regulations
Comprehensive cashless hospitalization and medical reimbursement under RGHS / Nigam Contributory Health Scheme
Company township residential accommodation at super thermal plants (Kota, Suratgarh, Chhabra, Kalisindh, Ramgarh) or HRA
Thermal Generation Allowance / Shift Duty Allowance for power station operational staff
Group Personal Accident Insurance, Contributory Provident Fund / NPS, and Gratuity on superannuation

competition_benchmarks.note: Common Recruitment in Rajasthan Power Companies for Junior Engineers is conducted jointly for all five Vidyut Nigams (RVUN, RVPN, JVVN, AVVN, JdVVN). In the 2026-27 recruitment cycle, 869 Junior Engineer-I vacancies (Electrical: 727, Mechanical: 110, Civil: 32) were notified out of 2,005 total vacancies. In the 2021 cycle, 946 Junior Engineer-I vacancies were advertised, drawing approximately 1,20,000 engineering applicants across Rajasthan.
